headline: Approved four personnel complement changes for city departments
summary: The committee approved creating a Payroll Administrator II position, upgrading a Benefits Manager position, changing Aviation Department accountant positions, and adding two Parking Control Officer positions. Each item was also voted to be expedited to the full Board.
decisions: Approved creating one full-time Payroll Administrator II position, grade 117, in the Human Resources Department.
Approved modifying one Benefits Manager position from grade 118 to grade 119 and updating its class specification.
Approved creating two Accountant II positions, grade 113, and eliminating two Accountant I positions, grade 108, in the Aviation Department.
Approved adding two full-time Parking Control Officer positions to the Parking Division complement.

plain_text:
COMMITTEE ON HUMAN RESOURCES/INSURANCE 
September 1, 2026 Immediately Following Committee on Administration 
 
Chairman Goonan called the meeting to order. 
   
The Clerk called the roll. 
 
Present: Aldermen Goonan, Sapienza, O’Neil, Burkush 
 
Absent: Alderman Vincent 
 
1. Communication from the Human Resources Director requesting the creation and 
addition of one (1) full-time Payroll Administrator II position, grade 117, to the 
department's complement. 
 
On motion of Alderman O’Neil, duly seconded by Alderman Burkush, it was voted to 
approve. 
 
On motion of Alderman O’Neil, duly seconded by Alderman Sapienza, it was voted to 
expedite the committee’s report to the full Board.  
 
2. Communication from the Human Resources Director requesting that one (1) 
Benefits Manager position be modified from grade 118 to grade 119, and that the 
position's class specification be updated. 
 
On motion of Alderman Burkush, duly seconded by Alderman Sapienza, it was voted 
to approve. 
 
On motion of Alderman O’Neil, duly seconded by Alderman Burkush, it was voted to 
expedite the committee’s report to the full Board.  
 
3. Communication from Tom Malafronte, Aviation Director, requesting the following 
changes to the department's complement: 
• Create two (2) Accountant II positions, grade 113 
• Eliminate two (2) Accountant I positions, grade 108 
 
 On motion of Alderman Burkush, duly seconded by Alderman O’Neil, it was voted to 
approve. 
 
On motion of Alderman O’Neil, duly seconded by Alderman Burkush, it was voted to 
expedite the committee’s report to the full Board.  
 
4. Communication from Ken Loui, Assistant Chief of Police, requesting the addition 
of two full-time Parking Control Officer positions to the Parking Division 
complement. 
 
On motion of Alderman Burkush, duly seconded by Alderman O’Neil, it was voted to 
approve. 
 
On motion of Alderman O’Neil, duly seconded by Alderman Burkush, it was voted to 
expedite the committee’s report to the full Board.
September 1, 2026 COMMITTEE ON HUMAN RESOURCES/INSURANCE  
Page 2 of 2 
 
There being no further business, on motion of Alderman Sapienza, duly seconded by 
Alderman O’Neil, it was voted to adjourn. 
 
A True Record.  Attest. 
 
 
     
      Clerk of Committee
